title: How partners and external systems authenticate to the Track3D API
question: Do partners get OAuth clients or API keys? Is a key issued per customer, per project or per partner; what can it reach; who creates, rotates and revokes it; and what rate limits apply?
context: The external capture PRD asks for OAuth (INTG-REQ-020) and the API PRDs for managed, rotated keys (INTG-REQ-022).
